🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL regime. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive; confirmations: strong Energy leadership (top 5 all Energy) and mixed Big Tech internals (NVDA ABOVE TREND vs AAPL/GOOGL BELOW TREND) support a neutral stance with selective rotation. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Energy).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing pockets of strength: LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +2.68%) ABOVE TREND. Financials steady: JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Staples weak: MNST (1W: -50.28% | 1M: -52.01%) BELOW TREND, sector showing weakness. Consumer Discretionary soft with HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND and TJX (1W: -5.44% | 1M: -1.42%) BELOW TREND. Materials slipping with FCX (1W: -4.50% | 1M: +13.54%) CORRECTION.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND; VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND; PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND; COP (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +12.35%) ABOVE TREND; CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Energy) — caution on concentration.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: MNST (1W: -50.28% | 1M: -52.01%) BELOW TREND; AMAT (1W: -5.93% | 1M: -9.58%) BELOW TREND; CSCO (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +1.84%) CORRECTION; AVGO (1W: -8.13% | 1M: +4.95%) CORRECTION; HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select Tech hardware and Consumer names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +2.68%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present (MSFT, AMZN, FCX, CSCO show 1W ≠ 1M) — watch for trend breaks and tactical volatility.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed internals with narrow leadership: NVDA (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.56%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, but AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -2.41%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: 13/24 positive — selective exposure favored; watch AMAT (1W: -5.93% | 1M: -9.58%) BELOW TREND as leading downside risk.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive across large caps: JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -0.09%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth: 12/20 positive — Financials supportive of cyclical/value exposure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed/defensive bias: JNJ (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +4.15%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +8.43%) ABOVE TREND, but UNH (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -5.11%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: 9/17 positive; watch BMY-related FDA headlines for incremental upside.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and select Financials/Industrials on current rotation; reduce exposure to lagging Consumer Staples and weak Consumer Discretionary names. Style: Cyclical/value leaning given narrow Energy leadership and mixed Tech internals; monitor megacap divergences before adding broad cyclical exposure.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: MNST (1W: -50.28% | 1M: -52.01%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +1.84%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (10/10 positive) and Financials (12/20 positive) on strong earnings/news flows. BEARISH: Consumer Staples (3/14 positive) and Consumer Discretionary (5/14 positive) as discretionary demand shows strain.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.56%) ABOVE TREND — needs sustained 1M follow-through to broaden Tech leadership. MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND — failure to hold weekly gains would signal profit-taking. AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND — reclaiming short-term trend needed to avoid deeper correction. JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND — hold above short-term trend to confirm Financial leadership.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
MPC (+65): Marathon headline; MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed by price. GOOGL (+60): Warren Buffett-related buying chatter; GOOGL (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -2.41%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from price, watch for follow-through. AMAT (+55): upbeat AI Q3 headline; AMAT (1W: -5.93% | 1M: -9.58%) BELOW TREND — bullish news but price not confirming, tactical watch.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ORCL (-60): funding concern headline; ORCL (1W: -X% | 1M: +Y%) CORRECTION — news aligns with pressure (note: monitor short-term reaction). META (-50): margin questions; META (1W: -0.38% | 1M: -11.24%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms ongoing weakness. CSCO (-45): margin squeeze chatter; CSCO (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +1.84%) CORRECTION — bearish sentiment coincides with sharp 1W sell-off.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with a cyclical/value tilt given concentrated Energy leadership. Energy names MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND and CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is major divergence among megacaps and mixed news-price signals (MSFT, AMZN, CSCO) — monitor for trend breaks and sentiment follow-through.
